tasks.title: CLP/JPY/KWD amounts rendered with the wrong number of decimals
tasks.summary: Updated `money.Amount.Decimal()` to format amounts using the currency's `Exponent` and `Factor()` rather than a hardcoded 2-decimal (`100`) divisor. Zero-exponent currencies (CLP, JPY) now render without a decimal point, and 3-exponent currencies (KWD) render with 3 decimal digits, while preserving negative signs and existing 2-decimal behaviour. Added unit and API tests covering CLP, JPY, KWD and other currencies.

tasks.title: Multiple partial refunds can exceed the captured amount
tasks.summary: Fixed `Service.Refund` in `payment/service.go` to check that the requested refund amount does not exceed `p.Remaining().Minor` instead of `p.Amount.Minor`, preventing cumulative refunds from exceeding the payment amount. Added regression tests in `payment/service_test.go` and `api/api_test.go`.

tasks.title: Cursor pagination silently drops one payment per page
tasks.summary: Fixed off-by-one bug in store.Memory.ListByMerchant cursor decoding where the decoded next-page start offset was incremented again, causing the first payment of every subsequent page to be skipped. Added pagination tests verifying all payments are returned in creation order without missing items across various page limits.

tasks.title: Webhook dispatcher retries permanent 4xx failures and gives up on 5xx
tasks.summary: Fixed `retryable` in `webhook/dispatcher.go` to treat 5xx (`status >= 500 && status < 600`) rather than 4xx (`status >= 400 && status < 500`) as transient retryable HTTP statuses alongside transport errors, 408, and 429, and added unit tests covering transient status retries and permanent 4xx dead-lettering.

tasks.title: Idempotency keys never expire after 24h
tasks.summary:
Fixed idempotency key TTL expiry and eviction in `idempotency.Memory`:
- Updated `purgeLocked` to evict records once `!now.Before(r.ExpiresAt)` (`now >= ExpiresAt`) instead of `now.Sub(r.ExpiresAt) > m.ttl`, which was double-counting the TTL since `ExpiresAt` is already set to `now.Add(m.ttl)`.
- Updated `Begin` to check `now.Before(r.ExpiresAt)` when looking up an existing key so keys that expire between throttled purge intervals immediately behave as unused at `now >= ExpiresAt`.
- Added unit and API tests verifying expiry boundaries and memory eviction.

tasks.title: Every client error is returned as 500 internal_error
tasks.summary: Updated `api/errors.go` (`errorResponse`) to match wrapped domain errors using `errors.Is` instead of direct equality (`switch err`), ensuring wrapped errors (`payment.ErrNotFound`, `payment.ErrInvalidTransition`, `payment.ErrVersionConflict`, `payment.ErrDuplicate`, `payment.ErrRefundExceedsRemaining`, `idempotency.ErrKeyReuse`, `idempotency.ErrInProgress`, `payment.ErrInvalidInput`, `payment.ErrInvalidCursor`, `money.ErrInvalidAmount`, `money.ErrPrecision`, `money.ErrUnknownCurrency`, `money.ErrCurrencyMismatch`) map to their documented HTTP status codes and error codes while keeping unexpected errors as 500 `internal_error`. Added unit and HTTP tests in `api/api_test.go`.

tasks.title: Late webhook retries fire with no delay
tasks.summary: Fixed integer overflow in `webhook.Policy.Backoff` when computing `BaseDelay * 2^(n-1)` for large attempt numbers. Previously `p.BaseDelay << (n - 1)` overflowed `time.Duration` (`int64`) around `n >= 35` (for `BaseDelay = 1s`), producing negative or zero durations that bypassed the `d > p.MaxDelay` cap and caused zero-delay retry storms. `Backoff` now doubles `BaseDelay` iteratively and returns `MaxDelay` as soon as `d > p.MaxDelay/2` (or when `BaseDelay >= MaxDelay`), preventing overflow and keeping backoff durations positive, monotonically non-decreasing, and capped at `MaxDelay` for any attempt number.

tasks.title: Add payment cancellation (CANCELED status + endpoint + webhook)
tasks.summary:
Implemented payment cancellation before capture (PAY-4502):
- Added `payment.StatusCanceled` ("CANCELED"), registered it in `ParseStatus`, and marked it as final in `Status.Final()`.
- Added `(*payment.Service).Cancel(ctx, id)` transitioning CREATED and PENDING payments to CANCELED and emitting `"payment.canceled"`, while rejecting other statuses with `ErrInvalidTransition` and missing payments with `ErrNotFound`.
- Added HTTP route `POST /payments/{id}/cancel` returning 200 with the updated payment, 409 `invalid_transition` when not cancelable, and 404 `not_found` for unknown IDs.
- Added unit and API tests covering cancellation and invalid transitions.

tasks.title: Filter the merchant payment listing by status
tasks.summary:
Added optional status filtering to payment listing:
- Added `Status` field to `payment.Page`.
- Parsed and validated the optional `status` query parameter (case-insensitively via `payment.ParseStatus`) in `GET /merchants/{merchantID}/payments`, returning `400 invalid_request` on unknown statuses.
- Validated `page.Status` in `payment.Service.List` and `store.Memory.ListByMerchant`.
- Updated `store.Memory.ListByMerchant` to filter payments by status while preserving creation order, full page sizes, cursor continuation, and an empty `next_cursor` after the last matching payment.
- Added unit and API tests covering status filtering, pagination over filtered results, and invalid status handling.

tasks.title: Replay a dead-lettered webhook event
tasks.summary:
Implemented dead-letter webhook replay in `webhook` and `api`:
- Added `webhook.ErrDeadLetterNotFound` and `(*Dispatcher).Replay(ctx, eventID) (bool, error)` to remove a dead-lettered event and re-deliver it using the configured retry policy while preserving the original event ID and payload and recomputing the signature at send time.
- Added `POST /webhooks/dead-letters/{eventID}/replay` route and handler returning `200 {"event_id": "<id>", "delivered": true|false}`, and mapped `webhook.ErrDeadLetterNotFound` to `404 not_found`.

tasks.title: Accept and return integer minor units, backward compatible
tasks.summary:
Added support for integer minor-unit amounts (`amount_minor`) alongside legacy decimal string amounts (`amount`) in `POST /payments` and `POST /payments/{id}/refunds`, while enriching payment and refund responses with minor-unit integer fields:

- Updated `createPaymentRequest` and `refundRequest` in `api/dto.go` to accept optional `amount` (`*string`) and `amount_minor` (`*int64`), validated via `resolveAmount` in `api/handlers.go` so that at least one is required and if both are provided they must denote the same value for the currency.
- Added `amount_minor`, `fee_minor`, `refunded_minor`, `remaining_minor` to `paymentResponse` and `amount_minor` to `refundResponse` in `api/dto.go`.
- Preserved cross-format idempotency replay and unknown-field rejection, and added unit tests in `api/api_test.go`.

tasks.title: Centralize the payment status machine in one transition table
tasks.summary: Added `payment.CanTransition(from, to Status) bool` as the single source of truth for allowed payment status transitions and refactored `Service` methods (`Authorize`, `Capture`, `Decline`, `Refund`) and `Status.Final()` to delegate status transition validation to `CanTransition`.

tasks.title: Idempotency store is not safe under concurrent retries
tasks.summary:
Synchronized all map and record accesses in `idempotency.Memory` under `m.mu` across `Begin`, `Complete`, and `Release`:
- Held `m.mu` for the full check-and-insert critical section in `Begin` so concurrent callers for the same key cannot both observe the key absent/expired and start duplicate operations, nor race with `Complete` mutating the record.
- Acquired `m.mu` in `Complete` and before checking `m.records` in `Release` to prevent concurrent map read/write crashes and data races.
- Added concurrency tests in `idempotency/store_test.go`.

tasks.title: In-memory repository shares mutable state with callers
tasks.summary: Fixed the data race and phantom refunds under concurrent `Service.Refund` operations by deep-cloning `payment.Payment` (via `Payment.Clone()`, which copies the `Refunds` slice) at repository boundaries in `store.Memory` (`Create`, `Get`, `Update`, and `ListByMerchant`) as well as when publishing events in `payment.Service.mutate`. Previously, `store.Memory` copied `payment.Payment` by value, leaving the `Refunds` slice header sharing its underlying array across callers and stored entries; when `Refunds` had spare capacity, concurrent `append` calls raced on the shared backing array and failed updates overwrote stored refund entries.

tasks.title: Idempotency Begin gets slower with every stored key
tasks.summary: Replaced the O(N log N) slice copy and sort on every idempotency.(*Memory).Begin call with an expiry-ordered doubly-linked list so purging expired keys and inserting/releasing keys run in O(1) amortized time while preserving exact expiry and eviction semantics.

tasks.title: Split payouts do not reconcile with the charged amount
tasks.summary: Fixed `money.Allocate` to use exact integer division and the largest-remainder method (breaking ties by lower index) instead of per-share float64 rounding, ensuring allocated parts always sum exactly to the original amount and differ from their exact proportional share by less than one minor unit.

tasks.title: Identical retries rejected as idempotency key reuse
tasks.summary: Computed idempotency fingerprints from the parsed, canonicalized request fields (path, merchant_id, and normalized money.Amount) instead of hashing the raw HTTP body in createPayment and refundPayment. This ensures retries with reordered JSON keys, whitespace differences, lowercase currency codes, or unpadded decimal strings replay the original response rather than returning 422 idempotency_key_reused.

tasks.title: Processing fees overcharged by one cent
tasks.summary: Fixed `money.Fee` in `money/fee.go` to compute processing fees using exact integer arithmetic (`a.Minor / 10000` and `a.Minor % 10000`) and round half-to-even (banker's rounding) to the minor unit, eliminating both the `math.Ceil` overcharge and `float64` precision/overflow issues for large `int64` amounts up to `math.MaxInt64`. Added unit tests covering rounding ties and large amounts in `money/money_test.go`.
